fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas, card surfaces, divider hairlines — the warm light gray that IS the page background

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, nav links, body copy, icon strokes — near-black with a barely-warm bias (never pure #000)

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces over the gray canvas, text on dark buttons, product image backgrounds

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Filled button background, active states, inverted UI surfaces — warm-tinted dark, never pure black

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary button fill, subtle dark UI accents

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, tertiary metadata, inactive nav items

black.$description: Black — Pure black for SVG icon fills and the occasional hard edge — functional, not brand

butter-cream.$description: Butter Cream — Hero display text accent — the single chromatic voice on the page, used only on oversized seasonal headlines over photography

europagronr2sh.$description: Headings, display statements, nav items, body emphasis — the hero font. Used at 232–245px with weight 400 and line-height 0.90 for the signature oversized editorial type. The ultra-tight leading locks massive letters into a single visual band. Subheads drop to 32–48px at weight 600–700.

europagronr2sb.$description: Small UI text, nav labels, button copy, captions, footer micro-copy. The functional sans — quiet, compact, only at 12–14px. The deliberate size gap between this and EuropaGroNr2SH creates a clear voice split: small = system, large = editorial.
